profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Backend Software Engineer at Google specializing in Data Infrastructure.

Currently, I architect petabyte-scale data pipelines for Google Workspace, bridging the gap between low-level system optimization and high-level business intelligence. I focus on building fault-tolerant systems that power GenAI feature adoption, user activity, experimentation, and regulatory compliance for millions of global users.

My Core Engineering Philosophy: I believe that "scale" shouldn't mean "expensive." My recent work has focused heavily on cost-to-performance optimization—re-architecting legacy processing systems to reduce runtime by ~85% (16h to 2.5h) and slashing cloud compute costs by 60% through improved resource efficiency.

Technical Expertise:

Distributed Systems: Designing event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub) and batch processing systems (MapReduce/Spark equivalents) that handle high-throughput ingestion without data loss.

Data Reliability: Implementing idempotent logging frameworks and automated validations to prevent "high-cardinality" and ensure 99.99% data integrity.

Full-Cycle Data Engineering: From raw ingestion to storage lifecycle management and final stakeholder visualization.

•Designed and iterated upon dashboard for PMs to visualize project information
